title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 13: David's first attempt to bring the ark, the death of Uzza and the blessing on Obed-Edom's house.

questions.text: What reason did David give for bringing the ark of God back?
questions.explanation: David said, "Let's bring the ark of our God back to us again; for we didn't seek it in the days of Saul."

answers.text: We didn't seek it in the days of Saul
The Philistines were about to capture it
A prophet had commanded it that day

questions.text: From which town did David want to bring God's ark?
questions.explanation: David assembled all Israel to bring God's ark from Kiriath Jearim.

questions.text: On what did they carry God's ark?
questions.explanation: They carried God's ark on a new cart and brought it out of Abinadab's house.

answers.text: On the shoulders of the priests
On a chariot of the king

questions.text: Out of whose house was the ark brought?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they brought the ark out of Abinadab's house.

questions.text: Who drove the cart carrying the ark?
questions.explanation: Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

questions.text: At whose threshing floor did Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark?
questions.explanation: When they came to Chidon's threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark.

questions.text: Why did Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark?
questions.explanation: Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark because the oxen stumbled.

questions.text: What did David call the place where Yahweh broke out against Uzza?
questions.explanation: David was displeased and called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

questions.text: Into whose house was the ark carried aside instead of into David's city?
questions.explanation: David was afraid and carried the ark aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house.

questions.text: How long did God's ark remain with the family of Obed-Edom?
questions.explanation: God's ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months, and Yahweh blessed his house.
